message: I wonder if Sally and Eauderourke are doing okay?
I snuck over to check on them, but--

name: Paqy
message: 「Of course we did? Big guy's huge, so his vantage point is way up high.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Plus, Flatty's looking down from the air. Tailin' 'em without gettin' caught is near impossible.」
Eauderourke walks along swaying his massive frame, while his companion Sally circles around him.

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, Prez. We just gotta let lots of people see the Boss, right?」

name: Sally
message: 「Then Boss, let's parade around here! The shopping district has lots of people, lots and lots, and lots of food.」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like they're both doing just fine without me worrying.」

name: Sally
message: 「Beef bowl, beef bowl, sparkle bowl~♪ All-you-can-eat pickled ginger\s07 Egg costs extra~」
The PR campaign in the shopping district is a huge success.
Probably mistaking Eauderourke's massive body for a mascot costume, little kids come swarming around him.

name: Paqy
message: 「When a bunch of brats stampede in, that's the natural outcome.」
Smiling brightly, the little kids rain punches and kicks down on Eauderourke.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Are you okay? That's gotta hurt, right? Are you having trouble breathing, Eauderourke?」

name: Sally
message: 「Take that! Poison stinger poke on the Boss~♪」
Sally is casually joining in too... or rather, she looks like she's instigating it, though I'll pretend I didn't see anything.
Watching Eauderourke, a Demon General, I feel it from the bottom of my heart.
Demons and humans can definitely coexist.
I'm the Demon Lord, sure, but even if I weren't, I'm certain I would have felt the exact same way.

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, why did you come to the Human World, Eauderourke?」

name: Sally
message: 「I came 'cause I wanna eat yummy food. Same for the Boss.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hm... hmm? Only little kids are coming over, huh?」

name: Sally
message: 「If I advertise KiraFes to these kids' moms and dads, that's an extra-large beef bowl for me.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, we don't have the budget for--」

name: Sally
message: 「Leave this to the Demon World's idol, Sally! With my sexy charm power, all the dads will be head over heels too~」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, belly sticks out. Still, belly gets hungry.」
Seeing how hard Eauderourke is trying encourages me. As the Student Council President, I have to work even harder!
